name: New York Zoo

categories.label: Zoo board filled before elephant crosses start twice
categories.labelVi: Phủ kín bàn trước khi voi qua vạch xuất phát lần 2
categories.hint: Win if every construction space is covered in time.

categories.label: Action strip spaces up to the starting space (win)
categories.labelVi: Ô trên thanh hành động tới vạch xuất phát
categories.hint: 1 point per Animal Acquisition space and per slot (occupied or empty) up to the start; 0 if the elephant lands exactly on start.

categories.label: Uncovered spaces on zoo board (loss)
categories.hint: Each uncovered space is -1 point when you lose.

winCondition: Fill the whole zoo board before the elephant crosses the starting space for the second time; otherwise you lose.

endCondition.description: Zoo board filled, or elephant circles the action strip twice.

notes: family: race-to-goal. Solo score only; improve your score next game.
